programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. programme.title: News Of Shenzhen
programme.desc: Presented as a leisurely variety show, the program revolves around the theme: 'Seek Paradise Along the Journey to Kunlun Mountain.' Throughout their travels, the adventurers will uncover lesser-known towns, each exuding its own unique charm. programme.title: Drama Serial 'The Scent Of The Wind'
programme.desc: The 114th drama serial follows two women, Rin (Mikami Ai) and Naomi (Kosaka Juri), who paved the way for nursing in the Meiji era. Each carries her own struggles, yet together they support one another as they race to protect the wounded and vulnerable, often standing up against powerful forces. Through conflicts and hardships, the two gradually grow. No matter which way the wind blows, this unconventional duo continues their journey in search of happiness.

programme.title: E6 - Nuclear Power Plant Disasters
programme.desc: Nuclear power offers incredible energy potential—but at a terrifying cost when it fails. Fatal Engineering revisits major nuclear disasters, from the 1986 Chernobyl meltdown to Fukushima’s tsunami-induced failure. With expert testimony and rare footage, we uncover the cascading engineering and human errors that led to radiation leaks, environmental devastation, and global panic. These sobering events forced the world to rethink nuclear safety forever.

programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: E4 - The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: E5 - Deadly Rivals
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

Driven by her unwavering love for her friends and family, especially her younger brother who she raised by herself, Billy must confront the wounds she's spent years hiding before she can reclaim her dreams-and finally discover whether someone, someday, was meant for her after all.

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: E16
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。
